title: MusicDrop v1.4.0 Available
changelog:
• Refined Modern Player: Top bar with MusicDrop pill, Audio/Video switcher, Queue, and PiP
• Streamlined Player Sheet: Drag handle, Now Playing status, title with chevron, quick heart & download, orange seek bar, solid white circle play button, and Save pill
• Fixed Header & Tab Insets: Home, Songs, and Playlists tabs never overlap or hide under the system status bar
• Dedicated Search Page: Tapping search navigates to the dedicated search page with full results and persistent search history
• Video Sizing & Edge-to-Edge: Full Screen toggle and 16:9 / Fill (Crop) / Wide aspect ratio switcher
